records.issue_text: Client sets `host.category` from a still-null categoryId after saving without a category, so the uncategorized category is not displayed until reload
records.rationale: In embeddable-host.js.es6 save(), the client only sends `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` and then sets `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`. If the user saves a new host without picking a category, categoryId is null; the server (embeddable_hosts_controller.rb) defaults to uncategorized_category_id, but the client-side categoryId remains null, so host.category is looked up with null and the template's `{{category-badge host.category}}` renders nothing until a reload.
